dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Thanks for asking. With everyone's help, I'm sure it'll all start taking a turn for the better.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: After the war ended, many people were gone... I just hope they all went to the same place as Auntie Atea. The more the merrier, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, that probably sounds a bit naive. But I really believe that people from Natlan will be reunited in the Night Kingdom after they've passed.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: This explains how Ancient Names are forged from the memories of heroes and passed down through the ages.
